# Nihar Ranjan Rout | Creuto

> Nihar Ranjan Rout is the Founder and CEO of Creuto, a founder-led product and engineering company based in Bhubaneswar, India. He has 8+ years in product management and has led 50+ products: mobile apps, web apps, custom software and ERP, and AI products. Work is done by an in-house team, starts with a PRD and a clickable prototype, and uses fixed milestones. Clients own all code. Creuto is an OpenAI Select Partner and has a 5.0 rating from 16 verified Clutch reviews.

## Start here
- [Homepage](https://www.niharrout.com/): Founder-led software company in India. Nihar Ranjan Rout and Creuto build mobile apps, web apps, AI products and custom software, from PRD to launch.

## Guides (written by Nihar Ranjan Rout)
- [MVP Development Cost in 2026: Agency vs Freelancers vs Squad](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/cost-to-build-mvp-2026): A transparent 2026 breakdown of MVP costs: agency markups, freelancer risks and dedicated founder-led squads compared. By Nihar Ranjan Rout.
- [Fixed Price vs Time and Materials: Which Contract Is Right?](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/fixed-price-vs-time-and-materials-software-development): Fixed price or time and materials? Compare both software contract models, learn the hybrid milestone approach and the clauses every buyer should insist on.
- [How to Add AI to an Existing Product: A 6-Step Plan](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/how-to-add-ai-to-an-existing-product): Add AI to a product you already run without wasting budget. A 6-step plan: pick one workflow, check your data, choose an approach, add guardrails, pilot.
- [How to Choose a Software Development Company: 12 Questions](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-software-development-company): Hiring a software development company? Use these 12 questions, a proposal comparison table and a red-flag list to pick a team you can trust.
- [Mobile App vs Web App: Which Should You Build First?](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/mobile-app-vs-web-app-which-to-build-first): Mobile app or web app first? Compare reach, cost drivers, speed and features, then use simple decision rules to choose the right start for your idea.
- [Creuto Is Now an OpenAI Select Partner](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/openai-select-partner): Creuto, the product and AI engineering company led by Nihar Ranjan Rout, is now an OpenAI Select Partner. What it means for teams building AI that works in production.
- [Enterprise AI That Works: LLMs and Vector Search Without Hype](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/pragmatic-enterprise-ai-workflows): How real enterprises deploy domain-specific RAG pipelines, triage agents and deterministic guardrails over company ERP data. By Nihar Ranjan Rout.
- [Product Scoping Framework: Cut 50% of Feature Bloat Early](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/product-scoping-framework-kill-feature-bloat): The 4-step framework used across 50+ software products to challenge assumptions, cut feature bloat and protect engineering budgets. By Nihar Ranjan Rout.
- [From PRD to App Store: The 10-Week React Native Playbook](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/react-native-mobile-app-playbook): A 10-week playbook for shipping iOS and Android apps: offline-first sync, geofencing, payment escrow and App Store approval. By Nihar Ranjan Rout.
- [Web Application Development: Build vs. Buy in 2026](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/web-application-development-build-vs-buy): When custom web application development pays for itself versus another SaaS subscription, with a real cost comparison and a build framework. By Nihar Ranjan Rout.
- [What Is a PRD? How to Write a Product Requirements Document](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/what-is-a-prd-how-to-write-a-product-requirements-document): A PRD (product requirements document) turns an idea into something a team can build. Learn the 10 sections, PRD vs BRD, and common mistakes.
- [Why Custom ERP Implementations Fail, and the Fix](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/why-custom-erp-implementations-fail): Why multi-department ERP projects stall, how to replace spreadsheets, and the architecture playbook for low-risk ERP cutovers. By Nihar Ranjan Rout.
